messages:
Ellie Park: hey all! i’m ellie — joining as a frontend eng (react/ux). based in boston. big fan of sketching skylines and doing quick rooftop doodle sessions when the weather's nice. excited to be here! :wave:
Juno Patel: welcome ellie!! :tada: rooftop doodles sound amazing. what's your favorite skyline to draw?
Ellie Park: thanks juno! prob nyc or boston — i love the jagged mix of old brick and new glass. also tiny habit: carry a pocket sketchbook and a foldable stool :grin:
Rafael Alvarez: omg foldable stool is peak engineer energy :laughing: we should plan a rooftop sketch jam. friday after 4? anyone else in sf/bos area?
Maya Chen: count me in for a virtual sketch hang. can share a camera and we can all doodle and chat. :sparkles:
Noah: welcome ellie. FYI your desk is on 4th near the coffee station — there’s an oat milk stash in the cabinet. coffee preference?
Ellie Park: oat latte forever. also allergic to raw cashews (desk snack heads up) — thanks noah!
Juno Patel: @welcome-bot can we add ellie to the 'rooftop-sessions' calendar? :calendar:
welcome-bot: Added Ellie Park to rooftop-sessions. First tentative meetup: Fri 16:15. See #events for details.
Ellie Park: super! i’ll bring a little pack of microns and a handful of stickers to trade. also open to any sticker-swap rituals.
Rafael Alvarez: sticker swap approved. also, quick q for IT — badge/keyboard setup?
Noah: IT sent a laptop provisioning email earlier today — check spam if you didn't get it. badge pickup is front desk after 9am.
Ellie Park: got the laptop email, thanks! badge pick up tomorrow. excited to meet y'all in person and to doodle on a proper skyline. :city_sunrise:
Maya Chen: welcome again — can’t wait for the rooftop sketch jam. maybe we can livestream a little for the remote folks :camera_with_flash:
Ellie Park: i’d love that. also low-commitment intro: if anyone wants to see my sketchbook beforehand, here’s a quick snap: https://img.redwood/mock-ellie-sketchbook (totally optional!)
Noah: looks great! see you at the coffee station — and welcome to Redwood 💚
